title: Wildheart wheel carries every Circle Night of the year, lists the sky and the program by season, opens in January with a door to the next season, and reads every date in its own zone

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-13, on the live site after LIVE-904: every Circle Night and meetup date on the wheel; the list beside the wheel to show the astro events and the group's featured events together, each season headed by its highlights; the year journey to start in January; a 'Next section' button two months into a section and a fast scroll that skips to the next; and the bug that 'Next Circle Night' read 'Wed Nov 4 · 2:00 AM' for 6:00 PM Los Angeles and the Foundation weeks read Jan 6 for Jan 5.

detail:
The wheel and the year journey drew only the stored rows: the Circle Night anchor (every other Tuesday, FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TU) and the four children the cron had materialised, so the year showed five Circle Nights; the sky map opened on the sign now with a flat list; the journey's section wore today's season; and every date on the site printed two hours and a day off, because the seed wrote true instants (`at time zone 'America/Los_Angeles'`) where the product stores the host's wall clock as UTC parts read in events.time_zone (lib/time/zone.ts, the locked convention).

THE DATA WAS THE BUG, NOT THE DISPLAY. scripts/seed-wildheart.mts and the regenerated scripts/seed-wildheart.sql now write `timestamptz 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM+00'` (the child occurrences `(d.day || ' 18:00+00')::timestamptz`), time_zone stays America/Los_Angeles, and the production rows were converted to match; every reader reads a Wildheart row exactly like any other event, no zone fold anywhere. lib/sites/site-events.ts (pure) expands a recurring anchor across a window through the one rule engine (lib/events/repeat-rule.ts expandRepeat) on the stored parts, de-duplicated against materialised children, a cancelled child's day left empty, cancelled rows dropped. lib/events/store.ts selects recurrence_rule and reads a Space's live series rows (listSpaceSeriesRows: every published anchor whatever its date, plus cancelled rows). lib/sites/menswork-data.ts expands the series through next year above the upcoming floor, so the chrome's date line names every coming Circle Night. The landing hands a page with a Wildheart block the series rows (metadata.space.series), and the block expands them once per page. The sky map lists the whole year by default in season sections headed by the season's name and theme from lib/theme/wildheart-seasons.ts (the leaf) and the modules its three signs carry; a phone's Coming up lists six. The year journey opens in winter, lists six passing dates per stop, opens a real 'Next section' button two months into a season (NEXT_SECTION_AFTER_DAYS) that glides to the next season's first day (a jump under reduced motion), and a fast wheel, trackpad or touch scroll (FAST_SCROLL_DELTA inside FAST_SCROLL_WINDOW_MS, FAST_TOUCH_PX_PER_MS) skips the season. No new dependency; the islands keep off lib/theme/wildheart.ts.

Shipped 2026-10-13: the seed and the production rows follow lib/time/zone.ts (wall clock as UTC parts), every Circle Night of the year on the wheel from the anchor's rule, the sky map in season sections, the journey opening in January with the Next section door and the fast-scroll skip.
